name: The Clockwork Catacomb
description: A mechanical crypt of suspicious furniture, theatrical lighting, and one confidence problem.

able.message: I have made one microscopic placement adjustment. The previous paradox was artistically defensible.

objects.name: Crooked Portrait
objects.description: A severe-looking inventor watches the room.
objects.reveal: Behind the portrait is a strip of red paint, a scratched numeral, and a Silver Key taped to the frame.

objects.name: Dead Jukebox
objects.description: Its display flickers even though nothing is playing.
objects.reveal: Kane taps the jukebox. The display flashes BLUE // 2.

objects.name: Dusty Terminal
objects.description: A green phosphor cursor blinks patiently.
objects.reveal: The terminal accepts no input, but one diagnostic line remains on screen.

objects.name: Moon-Locked Chest
objects.description: A silver keyhole sits beneath a crescent emblem.
objects.reveal: The Silver Key turns. Inside the chest are the Moon Seal and the final color clue.

objects.name: Glass Cabinet
objects.description: Mostly dust, one dead moth, and ABLE's sense of drama.
objects.reveal: The cabinet contains nothing useful. Kane is unimpressed.

objects.name: Exit Plaque
objects.description: Four colored circles are engraved in a row.
objects.reveal: The plaque confirms the order: RED, then BLUE, then GREEN, then YELLOW.
